reader.requirement: For an indexed file in sequential access mode, READ with or without NEXT (with or without RECORD) must retrieve the same next record; NEXT changes nothing.

edition-consulted.switches: the compiling program's edition baked on the connector, read by every DialectBehaviors.IsActive in the connector
DialectBehavior.IndexedReadPreviousAfterOpenAtEnd, guarded by 'previous &&': only READ PREVIOUS after OPEN; a NEXT walk at 85 takes the same code as 2023

reader.edition-search: read KeyedIoBinder.BindRead, KeyedIoEmitter.EmitRead and the IndexedConnector READ members; grep DialectBehaviors.IsActive|Edition|Year|DialectLevel over those files and the StatementValidation READ checks; CheckReadDynamicNextWritten and CheckReadRandomAccessPhrases return early for sequential access
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: no (BindRead's access-mode switch binds sequential access to ReadKind.Next whether NEXT is written or not, at every edition; only PREVIOUS is edition-gated)
reader.witnesses-cover: part: g85_f25_02; the probe adds READ ... RECORD with and without NEXT and the READ after at end

probes.printed: S1=00 01ZZ (READ) S2=00 02YY (READ NEXT) S3=00 03XX (READ NEXT RECORD) S4=00 04XX (READ RECORD) S5 END 10; S6 (READ after at end) took no AT END branch
probes.expected: prime-key order 01..04 whatever the spelling, then at end; a READ after the at end is unsuccessful but not at end (GR12, GR4a)

probes.printed: COBOL0900 READ PREVIOUS requires COBOL-2002; COBOL0864 READ KEY on a sequential-access file
probes.expected: PREVIOUS is not a 1985 phrase; format 2 not allowed for sequential access (SR4)

reader.notes: The binder binds a sequential-access READ to ReadKind.Next whether NEXT is written or not, so the emitted call is identical; probed alternating spellings.

refuter.evidence: q2seq-002 (sequential access, after START KEY NOT LESS THAN R-ALT). Plain READ, READ NEXT RECORD INTO, READ RECORD and READ NEXT alternate and walk the alternate key in one order: S1=00 03AA, S2=02 02BB (INTO filled), S3=00 04BB, S4=00 01ZZ, then S5 END 10. A READ after CLOSE gave S6=47. q5refuse-001: READ WITH NO LOCK (2002) is refused with COBOL0900 at 85. cite.py: OK §1985:IX.4.5.4 GR2.
